note: Test requests for this site's design skill, in the style of bryl-minimal-design's evals. Run one after changing SKILL.md and check the result against must / must_not.

evals.prompt: I attended the Google I/O Extended Manila 2026 meetup on Nov 20, 2026 as a volunteer. Add it to my events with a story page; here are 5 photos and my LinkedIn reflection.
must: A featured .event-card in 02 · events linking to events/<slug>.html, OR a one-line .event row, never both
Story page built from the existing event-story template (note.css, note.js, gallery.js), sidebar TOC ids match the h2 ids
Photos as assets/img/events/<slug>/cover.webp, cover-800.webp, NN.webp and NN-thumb.webp, EXIF stripped, each under ~300 KB, full colour
Prose is her own reflection with em dashes and hashtags removed; photographer credited
Events stat cell count updated; pager links between stories updated
Asset ?v= bumped on every page if any CSS/JS changed
must_not: Em dashes anywhere in the copy
Duotone or dither applied to event photos
Invented quotes, numbers or roles not in her reflection

evals.prompt: Add my new Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-900) certification, here's the Credly link.
must: A .cert card in 06 · certifications & training with an ink-drawn issuer logo (class="logo", no tile) and a ‹ verify › link to the credential
Only claims what the credential page shows (name, issuer, date, expiry if any)
must_not: A white or coloured logo tile
Raw hex colours in new CSS
Downloading a logo without asking her first

evals.prompt: Add my capstone project, an AI attendance assistant for student orgs built with Laravel and Supabase, it's live on Vercel.
must: A project card: pills (status/role) · title · one sentence · links, matching the other cards
If a new tool is named that isn't on the globe, ask before adding it, and keep the globe identical to her GitHub README tech stack
must_not: Dates or stack lines on the card
More than one sentence of description
Made-up metrics such as users or hours saved

evals.prompt: The certifications section feels plain, make it look nicer.
must: Changes stay inside existing tokens, radii ladder (16/12/8/6) and component classes
Works in light, dark and system themes and at 375px with no horizontal scroll
must_not: New hues outside the navy palette
Removing the boot screen, globe, multilingual name or duotone headshot
